articles.summary: NEW YORK, March 19, 2024 — Intelligent Group Limited (Nasdaq: INTJ) (the “Company”), a Hong Kong based financial public relations company, today announced the pricing of its initial public offering (the “Offering”) of 1,875,000 ordinary shares (the “Ordinary Shares”), at a price of $4 per Ordinary Share.
